documents.text: Department of Technical Education, Government of Rajasthan. Admission to 3-year Polytechnic Diploma Engineering programs requires candidates to have passed Class 10th (Secondary) examination with minimum 35% marks. Science and Mathematics are mandatory qualifying subjects.

Reservation Policy: SC candidates receive 16% reservation, ST candidates receive 12%, and OBC candidates receive 21% non-creamy layer reservation as per Government of Rajasthan norms. Women candidates have 30% horizontal reservation.

Government Polytechnic Tuition Fee Structure: The annual tuition fee for government polytechnic colleges across Rajasthan is fixed at INR 6,500. Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana and Uttar Matric Scholarship provide financial aid to eligible students.
